content.title: 2021 Chest Pain Guideline
content.description: The clinical guidelines provide insights into the management and assessment of chest pain, focusing on the diagnosis of cardiac-related conditions, the evaluation of obstructive coronary artery disease (CAD), and the use of various diagnostic tools and tests.

sections.details: Focuses on the American College of Cardiology, the American Heart Association, and other similar bodies providing guidance on the assessment of chest pain in stable ischemic heart disease.
Discusses advanced imaging techniques such as CT angiography for better assessment and diagnosis of coronary artery disease.

clinical_trials.description: A trial to test the efficacy of non-invasive testing on suspected CAD patients, focusing on functional versus anatomical testing.
Focused on using advanced imaging like CT angiography in patients with suspected coronary disease.
